2027 Campus Program-Lilly Marketing Academy
  • 上海

Lilly Marketing Academy (LMA) is a Trainee Program for Marketing function to build talent pipeline for future Marketing leaders. It is a global program that ran across many affiliates. LMA provides a great opportunity for individuals who are new to marketing with a strong desire in pursuit of long-term Marketing Career Path. The goal of creating Lilly Marketing Academy is to accelerate growth for young talents to be a successful Marketer and a potential future Marketing leader by building foundational Marketing capabilities and providing a variety of experience.

LMA is a 3.5-year rotational development program: half-year in medical representative of Business Unit, 1.5-year in Brand Team of Business Unit and 1.5-year in Central Marketing Organization. Detailed rotation for each individual will be based on business needs and individual interests.

The program will provide you with orchestrated learning and development resources, systematic training and development opportunities both in Marketing and leadership, to equip you with solid foundation for long-term career development in Marketing function.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Accomplish 3.5-year rotations in Medical Representative, Brand Team and Central Marketing Organization respectively during the program

  • Deliver business results as well as project deliverables as required

  • Build up solid marketing capability/foundation to successfully graduate from the program through the assessment

Qualification/Requirements :

  • Structure thinking and logical analysis

  • Continuous learning and agility

  • Problem solving

  • Good communication (influent English is required) and influence skill

  • Collaboration

  • Curiosity

  • Self-driven and resilience

  • High motivation for long-term development in pharma marketing

If External Candidates:

  • 2027 fresh graduates from domestic and oversea universities, no major limitation, major in Biology/Pharmacy/Chemistry is preferred

  • Marketing or pharma internship experience is preferred
